## Shiny

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(purrr)
library(plotly)
library(stringr)
library(officer)

# --- 1. Load and Prepare Data ---
application_inventory <- read.csv("Applications - Application_inventory.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
application_categories <- read.csv("Applications - Application_categories.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
application_error <- read.csv("Applications - Application_error.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
criteria_df <- read.csv("Criteria - Criteria.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
criteria_error <- read.csv("Criteria - Criteria_error.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
glossary <- read.csv("glossary_app.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

MODEL_TYPES <- c("Prediction", "Projection")
TOLERANCE_LEVELS <- c("High", "Medium", "Low")
TOLERANCE_COLORS <- c("High" = "#ffb3b3", "Medium" = "#ffffcc", "Low" = "#c2f0c2")
TOLERANCE_BORDER_COLORS <- c("High" = "#d32f2f", "Medium" = "#fbc02d", "Low" = "#388e3c")
CERTAINTY_COLORS <- c(
  "Always" = unname(TOLERANCE_COLORS["High"]),
  "Sometimes" = unname(TOLERANCE_COLORS["Medium"]),
  "Rarely" = unname(TOLERANCE_COLORS["Low"])
)
ERROR_TYPES <- c("Underprediction", "Overprediction")

repair_mojibake <- function(x) {
  mojibake_pattern <- paste(c("\\u00c3", "\\u00c2", "\\u00e2"), collapse = "|")
  needs_repair <- !is.na(x) & str_detect(x, mojibake_pattern)
  repaired <- iconv(x[needs_repair], from = "CP1252", to = "UTF-8")
  x[needs_repair] <- ifelse(is.na(repaired), x[needs_repair], repaired)
  x
}

repair_text_columns <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), repair_mojibake))
}

validate_columns <- function(df, required_cols, file_label) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        file_label,
        " is missing required column(s): ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

validate_columns(
  application_inventory,
  c("Application", "Application_category", "Description"),
  "Applications - Application_inventory.csv"
)

validate_columns(
  application_categories,
  c("Application_category", "Question", "Action", "Underprediction_error_effect", "Overprediction_error_effect"),
  "Applications - Application_categories.csv"
)

validate_columns(
  application_error,
  c("Error_effect", "Definition", "Error_effect_rank"),
  "Applications - Application_error.csv"
)

validate_columns(
  criteria_df,
  c(
    "Model_stage", "Model_step", "Criterion", "Description", "Violation",
    "Underprediction_prediction_error_certainty",
    "Overprediction_prediction_error_certainty",
    "Prediction_justification",
    "Underprediction_projection_error_certainty",
    "Overprediction_projection_error_certainty",
    "Projection_justification",
    "Solutions"
  ),
  "Criteria - Criteria.csv"
)

validate_columns(
  criteria_error,
  c("Error_certainty", "Definition", "Error_certainty_rank"),
  "Criteria - Criteria_error.csv"
)

validate_columns(glossary, c("Term", "Definition"), "glossary_app.csv")

application_inventory <- repair_text_columns(application_inventory)
application_categories <- repair_text_columns(application_categories)
application_error <- repair_text_columns(application_error)
criteria_df <- repair_text_columns(criteria_df)
criteria_error <- repair_text_columns(criteria_error)
glossary <- repair_text_columns(glossary)

application_categories <- application_categories %>%
  left_join(
    application_error %>% rename(
      Underprediction_error_effect = Error_effect,
      Underprediction_error_effect_definition = Definition,
      Underprediction_error_severity_rank = Error_effect_rank
    ),
    by = "Underprediction_error_effect"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    application_error %>% rename(
      Overprediction_error_effect = Error_effect,
      Overprediction_error_effect_definition = Definition,
      Overprediction_error_severity_rank = Error_effect_rank
    ),
    by = "Overprediction_error_effect"
  )

read_landing_docx <- function(filepath) {
  if(!file.exists(filepath)) return(rep("", 20))
  doc <- read_docx(filepath)
  content <- docx_summary(doc)
  text_lines <- content$text[content$content_type == "paragraph"]
  text_lines <- text_lines[text_lines != "" & !is.na(text_lines) & text_lines != "NA"]
  repair_mojibake(text_lines)
}

landing_lines <- read_landing_docx("tab1_landing_page_intro.docx")

# --- 2. UI ---

    "))
  ),
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"),
  titlePanel("SDM Application & Criteria Selector"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(

      selectInput("cat_select", "Select application category:", choices = sort(unique(application_categories$Application_category))),
      hr(),

# --- 3. Server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  selected_row_data <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  submitted_purpose <- reactiveVal("")

  rank_at_or_above <- function(rank_value, tolerance) {
    if (is.null(tolerance) || tolerance == "") return(TRUE)
    value_rank <- match(rank_value, TOLERANCE_LEVELS)
    tolerance_rank <- match(tolerance, TOLERANCE_LEVELS)
    !is.na(value_rank) & !is.na(tolerance_rank) & value_rank <= tolerance_rank
  }

  tolerance_label <- function(tolerance) {
    if (is.null(tolerance) || tolerance == "") return("No tolerance selected")
    paste(tolerance, "or higher")
  }

  selected_category <- reactive({
    req(input$cat_select)
    category_row <- application_categories %>%
      filter(Application_category == input$cat_select) %>%
      slice(1)
    req(nrow(category_row) > 0)
    category_row
  })

  selected_applications <- reactive({
    req(input$cat_select)
    application_inventory %>%
      filter(Application_category == input$cat_select) %>%
      arrange(Application)
  })

  selected_certainty_columns <- reactive({
    req(input$type_select)
    model_prefix <- tolower(input$type_select)
    c(
      underprediction = paste0("Underprediction_", model_prefix, "_error_certainty"),
      overprediction = paste0("Overprediction_", model_prefix, "_error_certainty")
    )
  })

  active_error_types <- reactive({
    category_row <- selected_category()
    severity_tol <- input$severity_tolerance
    active <- c()
    if (rank_at_or_above(category_row$Underprediction_error_severity_rank, severity_tol)) {
      active <- c(active, "Underprediction")
    }
    if (rank_at_or_above(category_row$Overprediction_error_severity_rank, severity_tol)) {
      active <- c(active, "Overprediction")
    }
    active
  })

  criteria_with_framework_fields <- reactive({
    cols <- selected_certainty_columns()
    criteria_df %>%
      mutate(
        Underprediction_certainty = .data[[cols[["underprediction"]]]],
        Overprediction_certainty = .data[[cols[["overprediction"]]]]
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        criteria_error %>%
          rename(
            Underprediction_certainty = Error_certainty,
            Underprediction_certainty_definition = Definition,
            Underprediction_certainty_rank = Error_certainty_rank
          ),
        by = "Underprediction_certainty"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        criteria_error %>%
          rename(
            Overprediction_certainty = Error_certainty,
            Overprediction_certainty_definition = Definition,
            Overprediction_certainty_rank = Error_certainty_rank
          ),
        by = "Overprediction_certainty"
      )
  })

  criterion_match_reason <- function(under_match, over_match) {
    if (under_match && over_match) return("Matched underprediction and overprediction")
    if (under_match) return("Matched underprediction")
    if (over_match) return("Matched overprediction")
    "Not selected"
  }

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    active <- active_error_types()
    if (length(active) == 0) return(criteria_with_framework_fields()[0, ])

    certainty_tol <- input$certainty_tolerance
    criteria_with_framework_fields() %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        Underprediction_selected = "Underprediction" %in% active &&
          rank_at_or_above(Underprediction_certainty_rank, certainty_tol),
        Overprediction_selected = "Overprediction" %in% active &&
          rank_at_or_above(Overprediction_certainty_rank, certainty_tol),
        Match_reason = criterion_match_reason(Underprediction_selected, Overprediction_selected)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(Underprediction_selected | Overprediction_selected)
  })

  display_certainty <- function(value, selected) {
    if (isTRUE(selected)) value else ""
  }

  get_tolerance_style <- function(level) {
    color <- TOLERANCE_COLORS[level]
    if(is.na(color)) color <- "#ffffff"
    paste0(
      "background-color: ", color,
      "; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold;",
      " border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); color: #333;"
    )
  }

  create_glossary_links <- function(text) {
    if (is.null(text) || text == "" || is.na(text) || text == "NA") return("")
    terms <- glossary$Term
    terms <- terms[order(nchar(terms), decreasing = TRUE)]
    processed_text <- text
    for (term in terms) {
      escaped_term <- str_replace_all(term, "([.|()\\^{}+$*?\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")
      pattern <- paste0("(?i)\\b(", escaped_term, ")(s|es)?\\b(?!([^<]*>))")
      if (str_detect(processed_text, pattern)) {
        term_js <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", term)
        term_js <- gsub("'", "\\\\'", term_js, fixed = TRUE)
        replacement <- paste0("<a class='glossary-link' onclick=\"Shiny.setInputValue('glossary_click', '", term_js, "', {priority: 'event'})\">\\0</a>")
        processed_text <- str_replace(processed_text, pattern, replacement)
      }
    }
    HTML(processed_text)
  }

  observeEvent(input$cat_select, {
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$type_select, {
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$severity_tolerance, {
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$certainty_tolerance, {
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$reset_filters, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "type_select", selected = "Prediction")
    updateSelectInput(session, "severity_tolerance", selected = "Medium")
    updateSelectInput(session, "certainty_tolerance", selected = "Medium")
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$submit_purpose, {
    submitted_purpose(input$user_purpose)
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "user_purpose", value = "")
  })

  output$full_landing_page <- renderUI({
    req(landing_lines)
    format_line <- function(line, idx) {
      if (idx == 1) return(div(class = "centered-intro", h3(create_glossary_links(line))))
      if (line %in% c("Overview", "Instructions") || str_detect(line, "^Step [A-Z]")) {
        return(div(class = "guide-section", h4(create_glossary_links(line))))
      }
      tags$p(create_glossary_links(line))
    }
    tagList(map2(landing_lines, seq_along(landing_lines), format_line))
  })

  output$selection_display_tab2 <- renderUI({
    req(input$cat_select, input$type_select, input$severity_tolerance, input$certainty_tolerance)
    div(
      class = "selection-bar",
      paste0(
        "You have selected: ", input$cat_select,
        " + ", input$type_select,
        " + severity tolerance: ", tolerance_label(input$severity_tolerance),
        " + certainty tolerance: ", tolerance_label(input$certainty_tolerance)
      )
    )
  })

  output$app_profile_display <- renderUI({
    category_row <- selected_category()
    apps_for_category <- selected_applications()
    active <- active_error_types()
    tagList(
      div(class = "profile-box",
          h3(style = "color: #2c3e50; border-bottom: 2px solid #2c3e50;", category_row$Application_category),
          p(strong("Question: "), create_glossary_links(category_row$Question)),
          p(strong("Action: "), create_glossary_links(category_row$Action))),
      div(class = "profile-box profile-box-muted",
          h4(style = "color: #18bc9c;", "Application Error Effects"),
          p(strong("Underprediction: "), span(style = get_tolerance_style(category_row$Underprediction_error_severity_rank), category_row$Underprediction_error_severity_rank), " - ", category_row$Underprediction_error_effect),
          p(create_glossary_links(category_row$Underprediction_error_effect_definition)),
          p(strong("Overprediction: "), span(style = get_tolerance_style(category_row$Overprediction_error_severity_rank), category_row$Overprediction_error_severity_rank), " - ", category_row$Overprediction_error_effect),
          p(create_glossary_links(category_row$Overprediction_error_effect_definition)),
          p(strong("Error types considered: "), ifelse(length(active) == 0, "None at this severity tolerance", paste(active, collapse = ", ")))),
      div(class = "profile-box profile-box-info",
          h4(style = "color: #2980b9; font-size: 1.1em;", "Applications in this category"),
          tags$ul(lapply(seq_len(nrow(apps_for_category)), function(i) {
            tags$li(tags$strong(apps_for_category$Application[i]), ": ", create_glossary_links(apps_for_category$Description[i]))
          }))),
      if (submitted_purpose() != "") div(class = "profile-box profile-box-purpose",
                                         h4(style = "color: #16a085; font-size: 1.1em;", "My specific application purpose:"), p(style = "font-style: italic;", submitted_purpose()))
    )
  })

  output$selection_display_tab3 <- renderUI({
    category_row <- selected_category()
    active <- active_error_types()
    tagList(
      h4(style = "color: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 10px;", "Model Use Summary"),
      div(class = "selection-bar",
          paste0("You have selected: ", input$cat_select, " + ", input$type_select),
          div(style = "margin-top: 10px; font-weight: normal; font-size: 0.9em; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); padding-top: 10px;",
              strong("Severity tolerance: "), tolerance_label(input$severity_tolerance), br(),
              strong("Certainty tolerance: "), tolerance_label(input$certainty_tolerance), br(),
              strong("Underprediction severity: "), category_row$Underprediction_error_effect, " (", category_row$Underprediction_error_severity_rank, ")", br(),
              strong("Overprediction severity: "), category_row$Overprediction_error_effect, " (", category_row$Overprediction_error_severity_rank, ")", br(),
              strong("Error types considered: "), ifelse(length(active) == 0, "None", paste(active, collapse = ", "))
          )
      ),
      h4(style = "color: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 20px; border-bottom: 2px solid #18bc9c; padding-bottom: 5px;", "Criteria selected based on application severity and criterion certainty")
    )
  })

  render_stage_plot <- function(error_type) {
    active <- active_error_types()
    if (!(error_type %in% active)) {
      return(render_empty_plot(paste(error_type, "is not considered at this severity tolerance")))
    }
    selected_flag <- paste0(error_type, "_selected")
    data <- filtered_data() %>%
      filter(.data[[selected_flag]]) %>%
      count(Model_stage, name = "n")
    if (nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(render_empty_plot(paste("No", tolower(error_type), "criteria selected")))
    }
    plot_ly(
      data,
      x = ~Model_stage,
      y = ~n,
      type = "bar",
      marker = list(color = "#18bc9c")
    ) %>%
      layout(
        xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -25),
        yaxis = list(title = "Criteria"),
        margin = list(l = 40, r = 20, t = 10, b = 90)
      )
  }

  render_empty_plot <- function(message) {
    plot_ly() %>%
      layout(
        xaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
        yaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
        annotations = list(
          text = message,
          x = 0.5,
          y = 0.5,
          xref = "paper",
          yref = "paper",
          showarrow = FALSE
        ),
        margin = list(l = 20, r = 20, t = 10, b = 10)
      )
  }

  output$radar_underprediction <- renderPlotly({
    render_stage_plot("Underprediction")
  })

  output$radar_overprediction <- renderPlotly({
    render_stage_plot("Overprediction")
  })

  output$criteria_count <- renderUI({
    filtered_count <- nrow(filtered_data())
    div(
      class = "criteria-count",
      paste0(
        "Showing ", filtered_count, " of ", nrow(criteria_df),
        " criteria for ", input$type_select,
        " models at ", tolerance_label(input$certainty_tolerance),
        " certainty."
      )
    )
  })

  output$criteria_tables_ui <- renderUI({
    data <- filtered_data()
    if(nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(div(class = "empty-state", "No criteria match this combination. Try lowering the severity or certainty tolerance, or selecting another model type."))
    }
    stages <- unique(data$Model_stage)
    map(stages, function(s) {
      tagList(
        h5(style="margin-top:15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc; font-weight:bold; font-size: 0.9em;", s),
        DTOutput(paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", s)))
      )
    })
  })

  observe({
    data <- filtered_data()
    for (s in unique(data$Model_stage)) {
      local({
        curr_s <- s
        output[[paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", curr_s))]] <- renderDT({
          df_subset <- data %>%
            filter(Model_stage == curr_s) %>%
            transmute(
              Criterion,
              Underprediction = mapply(display_certainty, Underprediction_certainty, Underprediction_selected),
              Overprediction = mapply(display_certainty, Overprediction_certainty, Overprediction_selected),
              Match_reason
            )
          datatable(df_subset, selection = 'single', rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE, columnDefs = list(list(width = '35%', targets = 0), list(width = '20%', targets = 1), list(width = '20%', targets = 2), list(width = '25%', targets = 3)))) %>%
            formatStyle('Underprediction', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(CERTAINTY_COLORS), CERTAINTY_COLORS)) %>%
            formatStyle('Overprediction', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(CERTAINTY_COLORS), CERTAINTY_COLORS))
        })
        observeEvent(input[[paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", curr_s), "_rows_selected")]], {
          idx <- input[[paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", curr_s), "_rows_selected")]]
          selected_row_data(data %>% filter(Model_stage == curr_s) %>% slice(idx))
        })
      })
    }
  })

  report_table_data <- reactive({
    data <- filtered_data()
    if (nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Message = "No criteria match the current selections."))
    }
    data %>%
      transmute(
        Criterion,
        Model_stage,
        Model_step,
        Underprediction_certainty = mapply(display_certainty, Underprediction_certainty, Underprediction_selected),
        Overprediction_certainty = mapply(display_certainty, Overprediction_certainty, Overprediction_selected),
        Match_reason
      )
  })

  output$report_criteria_table <- renderDT({
    report_df <- report_table_data()
    table <- datatable(report_df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE))
    if (!all(c("Underprediction_certainty", "Overprediction_certainty") %in% names(report_df))) return(table)
    table %>%
      formatStyle('Underprediction_certainty', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(CERTAINTY_COLORS), CERTAINTY_COLORS)) %>%
      formatStyle('Overprediction_certainty', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(CERTAINTY_COLORS), CERTAINTY_COLORS))
  })

  output$report_tab_content <- renderUI({
    category_row <- selected_category()
    tagList(
      div(class = "section-title", "Application Context"),
      div(class = "report-box",
          h4(style="color: #2c3e50; margin-top:0;", paste("Category:", input$cat_select)),
          p(strong("Selected Model Type: "), input$type_select),
          p(strong("Severity Tolerance: "), tolerance_label(input$severity_tolerance)),
          p(strong("Certainty Tolerance: "), tolerance_label(input$certainty_tolerance)),
          p(strong("Underprediction Severity: "), category_row$Underprediction_error_effect, " (", category_row$Underprediction_error_severity_rank, ")"),
          p(strong("Overprediction Severity: "), category_row$Overprediction_error_effect, " (", category_row$Overprediction_error_severity_rank, ")"),
          p(strong("Team Overview: "), input$team_overview)),
      div(class = "section-title", "The purpose of my model application"),
      div(class = "report-box", if(submitted_purpose() == "") p(em("No purpose described.")) else p(submitted_purpose())),
      div(class = "section-title", "Relevant criteria for your application"),
      div(class = "report-box",
          div(class = "criteria-count", paste0("Showing ", nrow(filtered_data()), " criteria.")),
          fluidRow(column(6, h6("Underprediction Criteria", align="center"), plotlyOutput("radar_underprediction_report", height = "280px")), column(6, h6("Overprediction Criteria", align="center"), plotlyOutput("radar_overprediction_report", height = "280px"))),
          hr(),
          DTOutput("report_criteria_table"))
    )
  })

  output$radar_underprediction_report <- renderPlotly({
    render_stage_plot("Underprediction")
  })

  output$radar_overprediction_report <- renderPlotly({
    render_stage_plot("Overprediction")
  })

  output$download_docx <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("SDM-Report-", Sys.Date(), ".docx", sep="") },
    content = function(file) {
      category_row <- selected_category()
      report_data <- report_table_data()
      active <- active_error_types()

      doc <- read_docx() %>% 
        body_add_par("SDM Application & Criteria Report", style = "heading 1") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Prepared by:", input$user_name), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Report Date:", input$report_date), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        
        body_add_par("1. Application Context", style = "heading 2") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Application Category:", input$cat_select), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Selected Model Type:", input$type_select), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Severity Tolerance:", tolerance_label(input$severity_tolerance)), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Certainty Tolerance:", tolerance_label(input$certainty_tolerance)), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Error Types Considered:", ifelse(length(active) == 0, "None", paste(active, collapse = ", "))), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Underprediction Severity:", category_row$Underprediction_error_effect, "(", category_row$Underprediction_error_severity_rank, ")"), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Overprediction Severity:", category_row$Overprediction_error_effect, "(", category_row$Overprediction_error_severity_rank, ")"), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        
        body_add_par("2. Purpose of Model Application", style = "heading 2") %>%
        body_add_par(ifelse(submitted_purpose() == "", "No specific purpose provided.", submitted_purpose()), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("Team Overview / Project Context:", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_par(ifelse(input$team_overview == "", "N/A", input$team_overview), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        
        body_add_par("3. Recommended Criteria", style = "heading 2") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Number of criteria included:", nrow(filtered_data())), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_table(report_data, style = "table_template")
      
      print(doc, target = file)
    }
  )

  output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("SDM-Criteria-", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep="") },
    content = function(file) { write.csv(report_table_data(), file, row.names = FALSE) }
  )

  output$details_panel <- renderUI({
    res <- selected_row_data()
    if (is.null(res)) return(p(em("Click a criterion to view details.")))
    justification <- if (identical(input$type_select, "Projection")) res$Projection_justification else res$Prediction_justification
    tagList(
      p(strong("Criterion: "), res$Criterion),
      p(strong("Model Stage: "), res$Model_stage),
      p(strong("Model Step: "), res$Model_step),
      p(strong("Description:"), br(), create_glossary_links(res$Description)),
      p(strong(style="color: #d63384;", "Violation:"), br(), div(style="font-size: 0.85em; background-color: #fff0f7; padding: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #d63384;", create_glossary_links(res$Violation))),
      p(strong("Selected Error Pathway:"), br(), res$Match_reason),
      p(strong("Underprediction Certainty: "), res$Underprediction_certainty),
      p(strong("Overprediction Certainty: "), res$Overprediction_certainty),
      if (!is.na(justification) && justification != "") p(strong("Justification:"), br(), create_glossary_links(justification)),
      p(strong(style="color: #27ae60;", "Potential Solutions:"), br(), div(style="font-size: 0.85em; background-color: #f4fdf7; padding: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #27ae60;", create_glossary_links(res$Solutions)))
    )
  })

  observeEvent(input$glossary_click, {
    term_info <- glossary %>% filter(Term == input$glossary_click) %>% slice(1)
    req(nrow(term_info) > 0)
    showModal(modalDialog(title = term_info$Term, p(term_info$Definition), easyClose = TRUE))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
